defs.def: to show that a day or an event is important by doing sth special on it 庆祝；庆贺

ex.s: This year, instead of cooking at home for her husband and friends, she celebrated the Chinese New Year with various dishes from local restaurants in Chinatown.
ex.t: 今年，她没有在家为丈夫和朋友做饭，而是用唐人街当地餐馆的各种菜肴来庆祝中国新年。

ex.s: This exhibition of some sixty masterpieces celebrating the life and work of Scotland’s best loved painter, Sir Henry Raeburn, comes to London.
ex.t: 这次展览展出约60幅杰作，庆祝苏格兰最受喜爱的画家Sir Henry Raeburn的生活和作品，来到伦敦。

ex.s: This year, we are celebrating our 50th anniversary.
ex.t: 今年，我们要庆祝我们的50周年纪念日。

ex.s: Nothing is too small to celebrate.
ex.t: 没有什么是小到不能庆祝的。

ex.s: Discover and enjoy 4 centuries of history, 5 acres of celebrated and award-winning gardens with parkland walk.
ex.t: 探索并享受四个世纪的历史、5英亩屡获殊荣的花园和公园步道。
为了庆祝一个冬季节日。

ex.s: （2）How did the students celebrate Mabry's birthday？ （no more than 15 words）
ex.t: (2)学生们如何庆祝马布里的生日(不超过15个字)?

ex.s: The event celebrate its 22nd anniversary with a great show of the very best of gardening,  making it one of the most popular events in gardening.
ex.t: 该活动以一场展示最佳园艺的盛大演出庆祝其22周年，使之成为最受欢迎的园艺活动之一。

ex.s: Some of the world’s most famous musicians recently gathered in Paris and New Orleans to celebrate the first annual International Jazz Day.
ex.t: 世界上一些最著名的音乐家最近齐聚巴黎和新奥尔良，庆祝首个年度国际爵士日。

ex.s: The day celebrates the importance of families.
ex.t: 这一天庆祝家庭的重要。

ex.s: May Day is a festival to celebrate the start of summer, with celebrations held across Europe and in parts of North America.
ex.t: 五一节是庆祝夏天开始的节日，庆祝活动遍及欧洲和北美部分地区。

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: Thanksgiving is celebrated mainly in North America, in October or November.
ex.t: 感恩节主要在北美， 10月或11月庆祝。

ex.s: It celebrates the end of racial inequality in the country.
ex.t: 它庆祝该国种族不平等的终结。

defs.def: to perform a religious ceremony, especially the Christian Communion service 主持宗教仪式（尤指圣餐）
to praise sb/sth 赞美；颂扬；歌颂

chunks.en: celebrate end / south / start / jazz / winter / life / chinese
chunks.cn: 庆祝结束 / 庆祝南 / 庆祝开始 / 庆祝爵士乐 / 庆祝冬天 / 庆祝生活 / 庆祝中文
